steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Stop her!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Stop that monster? Look at how many people she's already taken out!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Why not? You're always going on about how strong you are!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: I-I can't do it! She's a walking Catastrophe, can't you see?
(Ægirian) All that standeth before me shall perish.
(Ægirian) All that beareth arms against me shall return to dust.
(Ægirian) All that craveth death, step forth.

steps.name: 'Captain'
steps.text: What the hell are you mumbling about?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Huh? Captain? Where'd the captain go?

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: The captain fell into the river...!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: She... she sent him flying with just a single blow...
Ah, I forgot they can't understand me... Oh well.
Tell me, where is she?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: She? Who are you talking about? Don't ask me, I don't know anything!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Gyaaah!!!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You... you'll regret this!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hey! Don't just start running! Pull the captain out of the river first!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: That person...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Do you know her?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: She might be my coworker...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But, wasn't I the one who was appointed to this job? It took me forever to pry this job from Meteorite too...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hrmmm... Maybe she's here on another mission?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Well, seems like the bounty hunters are retreating?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's now or never. This is our chance to get out of the village.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: If there are other operators coming to the village, we might even have the upper hand.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Carol, the staircase is really dark. You should hold on to me.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Um, will you stop to talk to her?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hmm, if possible, then I might—
Yeeowwwwch—!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wooooahh!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: My nose... my nose...! How'd this door spring open on its own...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Huh? Why is someone crouching here...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Grani! What's going on—

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Everyone, shut up! Shhhh!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: ...Shush?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Yeah, you peasants couldn't possibly understand. Did you not see that walking Catastrophe?!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: No bounty hunter would be stupid enough to face her head-on! The only people foolish enough to swagger up to her are those who haven't seen her level entire cities!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Wow, did she really! You mean she can do that all by herself—

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Quiet, don't let her hear us!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You know, I was hoping she'd notice me—

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: I said be quiet!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Fine, fine...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Somehow these stories about her that are going around are even more outrageous than the ones we hear at Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: D-did that monster leave?

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: I.. I think so...!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Phew, she's finally gone... Nearly gave me a heart attack...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Y-yeah.

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: I thought just our team would be enough to handle this job, but how'd we get ourselves into this mess... How do we even deal with something like that—

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: —Wait a sec!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Oops.

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Ahh! You're that kid with the spear! Fancy running into you here!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: And the Chief's with you too! You delivered her right to us!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Grani, don't tell me you...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No no, they just seemed to be so well-behaved, I let my guard down!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Cut the chatter, and hand the chief over to us! Otherwise, you're gonna be talking to the business end of this blade real soon!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You mean with that little knife?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: ......Wh-when did that kid pull that spear out?!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Send the signal and call the others!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Also, go release the rest of those bugs that we used to destroy their crops. We'll show them what happens when they try to resist us!
